text: I loved this, so much! Such an awe-inspiring show, really. It's a story about lost love, where the protagonist finds it right at the start, and then it's gone, and then it takes all these twists and turns I didn't expect. The lighting, the water motifs, the music, the visuals, everything together, and they create these really, really breathtaking moments. Actors and dancers share the stage with synchronized swimmers and acrobats. Everything is incredibly precise. There's these really wild flips and dramatic dives into water, and the synchronized routines where the swimmers hold their breath for many, many seconds. It's balanced with really funny moments. I was completely swept up by it. It's imaginative, grand, and surprisingly moving. If you have a chance to go, go. Must see.
